title.zh: OpenAI Says It's Made Progress on a Second $1 Million Math Problem
title.en: OpenAI Says It's Made Progress on a Second $1 Million Math Problem

current_state.zh: OpenAI told the New York Times it has made 'substantial progress' on a second Millennium Prize math problem, with speculation pointing to the Hodge Conjecture, while its earlier Navier-Stokes claim remains unverified and mired in a credit dispute.
